description: This Java class defines a custom data type for handling boolean values specifically for MySQL databases within the Liquibase framework. It ensures that boolean values are stored as TINYINT(1) in MySQL if the database is detected as MySQL, overriding the default boolean representation used by Liquibase. The class extends Liquibase's BooleanType and customizes the database data type conversion logic.

classes.name: MySQLBooleanType
classes.description: A custom Liquibase data type that enforces boolean values to be stored as TINYINT(1) in MySQL databases, maintaining compatibility with older MySQL versions that represent booleans this way.

methods.name: toDatabaseDataType
methods.description: Overrides the method to determine the database-specific data type for booleans; returns TINYINT(1) for MySQL databases, otherwise delegates to the superclass.

methods.name: getPriority
methods.description: Overrides to increase the priority of this data type extension, ensuring it takes precedence over default implementations.
